newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end off lows, Cimpor gains.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end off lows, Cimpor gains.

text.p: 1635 GMT - Shares ended off lows to which they had been pushed by profit-taking, while cement group Cimpor and other stocks connected with the construction sector were generally positive.

*Traders said that Cimpor was being lifted by the approach of the dividend payment and optimism over its first quarter outlook. The association grouping the construction sector said on Tuesday that sector turnover in the first quarter grew 20 percent compared with the same period last year.
*But the profit-taking elsewhere in the market probably had still not fully run its course and there could be further easing on Thursday, particularly if New York finished weak, traders said.
*"The market is going through a period of consolidation after the strong gains. The correction is healthy and is making room for further (future) gains," said one trader.
*The PSI-20 .PSI20 index dropped 0.39 percent to 6,703.17 but May futures were more resilient, dipping just 19 to 6,691.
